aboutWhatItDoes: HealthYarn dey allow you ask health question for Yorùbá, Nigerian Pidgin, or English and hear confirmed general health advice with Nigerian voice. E no dey use AI cook up new medical answer.
aboutWhatItDoesNot: HealthYarn no dey diagnose sickness, prescribe medicine, or calculate personal dose. For any emergency or danger sign, go hospital straight.
